definitions.t_tile: L_SETUP + (L_RD + K) + ((R-1) + (C-1) + L_PE) + T_DRAIN + L_RQ + L_WB; R = C = 8; T_DRAIN = 8 FULL / 4 STRIP, x4 when flags.out_int32
definitions.mapping_ceiling: M*N / (64 * tiles): utilization if only the K MAC cycles of each tile counted
definitions.operand_bytes_per_cycle: A + W bytes read per STREAM cycle: FULL 8 A + 8 W = 16; STRIP 4 A + 16 W = 20
definitions.arithmetic_intensity: mac_useful / (tiles * K * operand_bytes_per_cycle): useful MACs per operand byte actually streamed from ABUF + WBUF (zero-padded lanes included; requant params and outputs excluded)
